notes: Pad-center distances are a gross bridging floor, not IEC 61010 creepage certification.
Gold observed min HV↔LV pad-center is above 2.5 mm; adversarial copper at 0.5 mm must fire.
Net-class clearance in gold is not HV-specific (Big class includes V_HV and V_USB) — do not use net-class as the gate.
